summary: A model file with a YAML mistake now shows the line of the error and an Open file button, instead of looking empty or not found.
A diagram no longer fails to open when another program is writing its file at the same moment.
Try the Sample Project on a machine without Git now offers a Download ZIP button instead of failing.
A diagram file with a JSON mistake now shows the line and what is wrong, with Open at Line, and files starting with a BOM open.
A Draw from dbt that fails part-way now removes the diagram file it wrote and restores any table file it changed.
